args.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: transparent reusable children's illustration key pose, ONE bird only. Create a freshly drawn fairy pitta in exactly the established Num-Num Numbers picture-book character style. Input image 1 is the adopted identity/colour/ink/paper-texture reference. Input image 2 is ONLY the target thinking pose and proportions: standing upright, body facing slightly left, head tilted gently up, far wing raised towards beak/chest in a thinking gesture, near wing folded at side, both pink feet visible and grounded. Recreate this pose from scratch without reusing blurry pixels. Keep the same round simplified bird-like-prop design, warm brown hand-painted contour, broad green/cream/rust/red/blue colour fields, warm subtle watercolour paper texture, small grey beak, compact proportions, NOT a natural-history bird drawing. The visible eye must be a single plain SOLID BROWN ROUND DOT matching image1: absolutely no white/cream glint, highlight, white sclera, sparkle, black pupil or extra eye. The angle may tilt with the head but remains a solid round dot. Full beak, wings, short tail and two feet complete with comfortable transparent margins. Match the softness and warmth of the reference line and pigment; no hard dark vector line, no extra feather detail, no new accessories, no text, no ground shadow, no background. Fully transparent PNG; inside the bird all colour areas are solid with subtle opaque paper grain; no accidental alpha holes.
